data.explanation: US federal rules require this bank to re-confirm once a year that it has the correct address for customers who live outside the United States. You need to fill in the enclosed address certification form and send it back, either by mail or by uploading it, by the deadline shown. If the form does not arrive in time, the bank says it will restrict online access to your account until it receives it. Since this is a request from a foreign (US) bank involving personal documents, it is worth double-checking through an official bank channel that the letter is genuine before you send anything.
